squads_public:
SELECT s.id,
    s.name,
    s.tag,
    s.bio,
    s.created_at,
    cp.username AS captain_username,
    cp.ign AS captain_ign,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM squad_members m
          WHERE m.squad_id = s.id) AS member_count,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('username', p.username, 'ign', p.ign, 'role', m.role) ORDER BY m.joined_at), '[]'::jsonb) AS members
           FROM squad_members m
             JOIN profiles p ON p.id = m.user_id
          WHERE m.squad_id = s.id) AS members,
    s.logo_url
   FROM squads s
     JOIN profiles cp ON cp.id = s.captain
  ORDER BY s.created_at DESC;
city_squads_public:
SELECT s.id,
    s.name,
    s.city,
    s.state,
    s.description,
    s.slots,
    s.status,
    s.creator,
    p.ign AS host_ign,
    p.username AS host_username,
    p.avatar_url AS host_avatar,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM city_squad_applications a
          WHERE a.squad_id = s.id AND a.status = 'accepted'::text) AS members
   FROM city_squads s
     JOIN creators c ON c.user_id = s.creator AND c.active
     JOIN profiles p ON p.id = s.creator;
squad_battle_board:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.squad_battle_board()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'rows', coalesce((
    with match_pts as (
      select squad, sum(points) as pts, sum(kills) as kills, count(*) filter (where placement = 1) as wins
      from lb_entries group by squad
    ),
    squad_xp as (
      select s.name, coalesce(sum(g.xp),0) as xp
      from squads s
      left join squad_members m on m.squad_id = s.id
      left join player_game_stats g on g.user_id = m.user_id
      group by s.name
    )
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'squad', coalesce(mp.squad, sx.name),
      'match_points', coalesce(mp.pts,0), 'kills', coalesce(mp.kills,0), 'wins', coalesce(mp.wins,0),
      'squad_xp', coalesce(sx.xp,0),
      'total', coalesce(mp.pts,0) + coalesce(sx.xp,0)
    ) order by (coalesce(mp.pts,0) + coalesce(sx.xp,0)) desc)
    from match_pts mp full outer join squad_xp sx on sx.name = mp.squad
  ), '[]'::jsonb));
end $function$
my_squad_invites:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_squad_invites()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  if v_uid is null then return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'Log in first.'); end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'invites', coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', i.id, 'squad', s.name, 'tag', s.tag, 'by', coalesce(p.ign, p.username)))
    from public.squad_invites i
    join public.squads s on s.id = i.squad_id
    left join public.profiles p on p.id = i.invited_by
    where i.invited = v_uid and i.status = 'pending'), '[]'::jsonb));
end $function$
wars_board:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.wars_board()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'wars', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', w.id, 'challenger', c.name, 'opponent', o.name, 'status', w.status,
      'scheduled_at', w.scheduled_at, 'result', w.result,
      'winner', case when w.winner_id = c.id then c.name when w.winner_id = o.id then o.name else null end,
      'challenger_id', w.challenger_id, 'opponent_id', w.opponent_id) order by w.created_at desc)
    from public.squad_wars w join public.squads c on c.id = w.challenger_id join public.squads o on o.id = w.opponent_id), '[]'::jsonb));
end $function$
matchmaker_tick:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.matchmaker_tick()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v record; v_lobbies jsonb; v_squads jsonb; v_n int := 0; v_week text := to_char(now(), 'IYYY-IW');
begin
  select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind','lobby','label','LFG lobby: ' || coalesce(l.mode,'BR') || ' (' || coalesce(l.rank_min,'any') || '-' || coalesce(l.rank_max,'any') || ')', 'id', l.id))
    into v_lobbies from public.lfg_lobbies l where l.status = 'open' limit 3;
  select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind','squad','label','Squad recruiting: ' || s.name, 'id', s.id))
    into v_squads from (
      select s.id, s.name, count(m.user_id) as members from public.squads s
      left join public.squad_members m on m.squad_id = s.id
      group by s.id, s.name having count(m.user_id) < 4 order by s.created_at desc limit 3) s;
  if v_lobbies is null and v_squads is null then return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'sent', 0, 'note', 'nothing open to suggest'); end if;
  for v in
    select p.id, coalesce(p.ign, p.username, 'player') as name
    from public.profiles p
    where p.id is not null
      and not exists (select 1 from public.squad_members m where m.user_id = p.id)
      and exists (select 1 from public.player_game_stats s where s.user_id = p.id and s.updated_at > now() - interval '14 days')
    limit 25
  loop
    perform public.notify(v.id, 'matchmaker', 'Squad suggestions for you',
      'You are squadless. Open spots now: ' ||
        coalesce((select string_agg(x->>'label', ' · ') from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(v_lobbies,'[]'::jsonb) || coalesce(v_squads,'[]'::jsonb)) x), 'check the Squads page') ||
        '. Find them on the Squads page.',
      'squads.html', 'mm:' || v_week);
    v_n := v_n + 1;
  end loop;
  if v_n > 0 then
    insert into public.audit_log (actor, action, details) values ('squad-matchmaker', 'suggestions_sent', jsonb_build_object('players', v_n));
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'sent', v_n);
end $function$
push_feed:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.push_feed(p_since_notif bigint DEFAULT '-1'::integer, p_since_dm timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_since_room timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_since_tourn timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_squad uuid;
begin
  if v_uid is null then return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'Log in first.'); end if;
  select squad_id into v_squad from public.squad_members where user_id = v_uid;
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'now', now(),
    'notifications', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(t) from (
      select id, title, body from public.notifications
      where user_id = v_uid and id > p_since_notif
      order by id asc limit 10) t), '[]'::jsonb),
    'dms', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(t) from (
      select m.created_at, m.kind, coalesce(pr.ign, pr.username, 'player') as by
      from public.dm_messages m
      join public.dm_threads th on th.id = m.thread_id
      left join public.profiles pr on pr.id = m.sender_id
      where (th.user_a = v_uid or th.user_b = v_uid)
        and m.sender_id <> v_uid
        and (p_since_dm is null or m.created_at > p_since_dm)
      order by m.created_at asc limit 10) t), '[]'::jsonb),
    'rooms', case when v_squad is null then '[]'::jsonb else coalesce((select jsonb_agg(t) from (
      select m.created_at, left(m.body, 80) as body, coalesce(pr.ign, pr.username, 'player') as by,
             (select name from public.squads where id = v_squad) as squad
      from public.squad_room_messages m
      left join public.profiles pr on pr.id = m.user_id
      where m.squad_id = v_squad and m.user_id <> v_uid
        and (p_since_room is null or m.created_at > p_since_room)
      order by m.id asc limit 10) t), '[]'::jsonb) end,
    'tournaments', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(t) from (
      select name, date_text, prize from public.tournaments
      where status = 'upcoming' and (p_since_tourn is null or created_at > p_since_tourn)
      order by created_at asc limit 5) t), '[]'::jsonb)
  );
end $function$
set_squad_logo:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_squad_logo(p_squad uuid, p_logo text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ begin if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'not_authenticated'; end if; if p_logo !~ '^https://res.cloudinary.com/' then raise exception 'invalid_logo_url'; end if; update squads set logo_url = p_logo where id = p_squad and captain = auth.uid(); if not found then raise exception 'not_found_or_not_owner'; end if; end; $function$
squad_board:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.squad_board(p_scope text DEFAULT 'global'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare u uuid := auth.uid(); mp profiles%rowtype;
begin
  if u is not null then select * into mp from profiles where id=u; end if;
  if p_scope in ('state','district') and (u is null or mp.geo_state is null) then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'error','location_required'); end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'scope',p_scope,'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(t order by (t->>'rank')::int) from (
    select jsonb_build_object('rank',rank() over (order by sum(coalesce(g.xp,0)) desc),'id',s.id,'name',s.name,'tag',s.tag,'logo',s.logo_url,'members',count(*),'xp',sum(coalesce(g.xp,0)),
      'state',cp.geo_state,'district',cp.geo_district) t
    from squads s join squad_members m on m.squad_id=s.id left join player_game_stats g on g.user_id=m.user_id left join profiles cp on cp.id=s.captain
    where (p_scope='global' or (p_scope='state' and cp.geo_state=mp.geo_state) or (p_scope='district' and cp.geo_state=mp.geo_state and cp.geo_district=mp.geo_district))
    group by s.id,s.name,s.tag,s.logo_url,cp.geo_state,cp.geo_district order by sum(coalesce(g.xp,0)) desc limit 50) z),'[]'::jsonb));
end $function$
city_squad_applicants:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.city_squad_applicants(p_squad bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if not exists(select 1 from city_squads where id=p_squad and creator=auth.uid()) then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'error','Host only.'); end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'applicants',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',a.id,'name',coalesce(p.ign,p.username),'username',p.username,'status',a.status,'note',a.note,'kd',p.kd,'matches',p.matches,'wins',p.wins,'rank',p.ff_rank) order by a.id) from city_squad_applications a join profiles p on p.id=a.user_id where a.squad_id=p_squad and a.status<>'withdrawn'),'[]'::jsonb));
end $function$
city_squad_close:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.city_squad_close(p_squad bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update city_squads set status='closed' where id=p_squad and (creator=auth.uid() or is_admin());
  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'error','Not your squad.'); end if; return jsonb_build_object('ok',true);
end $function$
